scripts.build: sh -c 'command -v forge >/dev/null && forge build || echo "forge not installed; skipping contracts build"'
scripts.lint: sh -c 'command -v forge >/dev/null && forge fmt --check || echo "forge not installed; skipping contracts lint"'
scripts.test: sh -c 'command -v forge >/dev/null && forge test || echo "forge not installed; skipping contracts tests"'
scripts.typecheck: sh -c 'command -v forge >/dev/null && forge build || echo "forge not installed; skipping contracts typecheck"'
